title: DGX SuperPOD - GPU Profiling
description: Per-component GPU temperature / power / clock profiling for the DGX SuperPOD fleet (thousands of GPUs). All-fleet line charts are replaced with topk outlier views and 'hottest / highest' offender tables so spikes and over-threshold components are immediately visible. Throttle bitmask is decoded to words. XID / NVLink events come from Loki. The DCGM / node_exporter / UFM panels remain; the Redfish/BMC exporter is now LIVE (574 BMCs) and out-of-band per-GPU component temps & power are wired in the 'Redfish / BMC' row.

list.name: dgx_flavor
list.label: DGX Flavor
list.description: Display label for the DGX platform. The installer sets this from the DGX_FLAVOR env var.

list.name: search
list.label: Log search (regex, case-insensitive)
list.description: Free-text filter for the XID / NVLink Loki panel. Examples: Xid | nvlink | ECC | fell off the bus

panels.title: GPU Chip Temperature — outliers + hottest chips (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP)
GPU Chip Temp °C — top 20 hottest (spikes / outliers only)
panels.description: Per-GPU chip temperature across the fleet is ~2300 series and unreadable. This shows only the 20 hottest GPUs so temperature spikes stand out.

panels.title: Hottest GPU chips ≥ 60 °C (empty = healthy)
panels.description: Instant list of every GPU chip at or above 60 °C, sorted hottest first. Empty table means no chip is running hot.

panels.title: GPU Memory (HBM) Temperature — outliers + hottest modules (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP)
GPU Power — total + outliers + highest draw (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE)
Highest-power GPUs ≥ 1000 W (empty = none near limit)
GPUs actively throttling (real reasons only)
panels.description: Count of GPUs with a GENUINE fault throttle bit set (HW Slowdown 8, SW Thermal 32, HW Thermal 64, HW Power Brake 128 = mask 232). GPU Idle(1), App Clocks(2), SW Power Cap(4) and Sync Boost(16) are EXCLUDED — they are normal operation, not faults.

panels.title: Active throttle reasons per GPU — decoded (empty = no real throttling)
panels.description: Each column is a throttle reason decoded from the bitmask; 1 = active. Only GPUs with at least one real throttle bit are listed. Idle (1) / App Clocks (2) are ignored.

targets.expr: clamp_max((bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}, 4)) and on(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]) > 0) and on(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster"} > 50), 1)

panels.title: Thermal / Power violation counters > 0 (µs throttled, empty = healthy)
panels.description: GPUs that have accumulated thermal or power violation time. Value is DCGM's violation counter (microseconds spent below requested clocks).

panels.title: Interconnect — NVLink bandwidth outliers + PCIe replay errors
PCIe replay counter > 0 (empty = healthy)
panels.description: GPUs reporting PCIe replays — a sign of a marginal PCIe link.

panels.title: Node hwmon sensors °C — top 20 hottest
panels.description: Board / NIC / component temperatures reported by node_exporter (node_hwmon_temp_celsius). ~26k series fleet-wide — only the 20 hottest are shown.

panels.title: XID / NVLink error events (Loki — there is no DCGM XID metric)
XID / NVLink error log events
panels.description: XID and NVLink error events come from logs, not DCGM. Default filter matches xid|nvlink; add extra terms in the Log search box.

panels.title: Redfish / BMC per-GPU component temps & power (out-of-band, 574 BMCs — LIVE)
BMC GPU/HBM sensor temp °C — top 20 hottest (redfish_temperature_celsius, HGX_GPU*)
panels.description: Out-of-band GPU/HBM temps from the BMC (Redfish). Bad-sensor sentinel readings filtered with < 150.

panels.title: BMC GPU sensors ≥ 65 °C (empty = healthy)
panels.description: Every BMC-reported GPU/HBM sensor at or above 65 °C.

panels.title: BMC GPU component power W — top 20 (redfish_component_power_watts, HGX GPU *)
panels.description: Per-GPU package power reported out-of-band by the BMC.

panels.title: Highest BMC GPU component power — top 40
panels.description: Top 40 GPU component power draws reported by the BMC.
